blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: That's cute and all, but it isn't feasible.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: There was thunder and then it started to rain.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I didn't know, but I guessed.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He does not paint the walls, but wallpapers them.
exercises.ru: Он не красит стены, ___ наклеивает на них обои.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She can speak not only German but also Lower Sorbian.

exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Marika is Finnish, but she speaks German.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: But no one's lifted a finger.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: History doesn't repeat itself, but it often rhymes.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It's harsh, but fair.

exercises.q: "Mom, do farts weigh anything?" "No, sweety." "Then I pooped my pants."
exercises.ru: "Мама, ___ пуки имеют вес?" - "Нет, мой милый". - "Значит, я обкакался".

exercises.q: It's not the volts that kill you, it's the amps.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I sent it, but I forgot the attachment.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Paradoxically, drinkable water is the first thing in short supply after a flood.
exercises.ru: Парадоксально, ___ питьевая вода — первое, чего не хватает, когда случаются наводнения.

exercises.q: It's a stuffed parrot, and I need a live bird.
exercises.ru: Это чучело попугая, ___ мне нужна живая птица.

exercises.q: Yesterday, I asked Hiromi out on a date, but she rejected my offer out of hand.

exercises.q: We protested, but it was in vain.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This is a cargo ship, not a passenger ship.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom's a night owl, but he's very sluggish in the morning.
exercises.ru: Том полуночник, ___ по утрам он очень вялый.
